<div class="poem">

<p>
Intuition comes in two—<br>
warm and cold.
</p>

<p>
The warm is joy,<br>
the heart’s own way.<br>
The cold is grammar,<br>
our common way.
</p>

<p>
Learning takes the cold in hand<br>
and kindles there a flame.<br>
Research lets the warm run wild<br>
and gives the flame a frame.
</p>

<p>
Talent is its voltage.
</p>

<p>
Frame into flame,<br>
flame into frame—<br>
round and round again.
</p>

<p>
Yet even a circle needs a first step.
</p>

<p>
Let mine be warm.
</p>

</div>
